# ZippyScale

> Real estate marketing team for solo realtors in North America with 6+ closings a year. We build the realtor's city guides, run ads in the realtor's name, follow up with every lead by text and email, and buyers and sellers book calls on the realtor's calendar. Based in Vancouver, Canada.

## What ZippyScale does
- Writes local guides for the realtor's city (first-time buyers, condos, relocation, downsizing, selling) with the realtor's name on them.
- Runs Facebook and Instagram ads in the realtor's name and brokerage. The realtor approves every ad before it runs.
- Follows up by text and email with everyone who asks for a guide, and books buyers and sellers planning to move in the next 90 days onto the realtor's calendar.
- Works with one realtor per city. The realtor keeps every lead in a shared sheet.

## Who it is for
Solo realtors (not large teams) with 6 or more closings a year who want buyers and sellers from outside their sphere of referrals.

## Track record
- Real estate marketing since 2023.
- $130k+ in ad spend managed, $2M+ in client GCI tracked.
- Campaigns run for realtors in British Columbia, Alberta and Ontario.

## How it works
The realtor funds their own ad budget. The rest of the setup is due once the first 3 qualified appointments show up. No-shows do not count.
